title: Criatura IA Protocol v2
supersedes: protocol-v1.json (Task 001). v2 = voxel world, Task 002 etapa 1. Brains trained on v1 are incompatible.

vision.layout: 72 rays (3 pitch rows x 24 yaw) x 13: distance/range, one-hot [none, soil, sand, stone, snow, water, wood, leaves, plant, thorny, meat, creature]

creatureSectors.layout: 4 yaw sectors of the eye row x (r, g, b, relative size clamp 0..4, carnivore 0/1), averaged over hits

olfaction.layout: plants, water, creatures, threat; each (body, nose-body, right-body)

proprioception.layout: local velocity xyz /10, turn, on floor, head pitch, sleeping, in water, climbing, blocked

interoception.layout: energy, water, body temperature, head, torso, legs, fatigue, pain, libido, age fraction, mature, fear

time.layout: sin, cos of time of day

flow.lockstep: Godot sends STEP(tick) and pauses; Python answers with zero or more SPAWN frames followed by exactly one ACT(tick).
flow.spawn: SPAWN ids must be new (never reused). The spawned creature is created before physics resumes and first appears in STEP(tick+1). It is not part of ACT(tick).
flow.traits: trait_count 0 = default body (genome arrives in etapa 2).

STEP: event_count * (u8 type + u16 length + bytes payload)
